# spirl_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieves a service account by name. Use this data source to look up a service account ID for use in other resources such as `spirl_service_account_wif_config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spirl_service_account" "deployer" {
  name = "my-deployer-sa"
}

output "deployer_id" {
  value = data.spirl_service_account.deployer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service account.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An RFC3339 timestamp for when the service account was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the service account.
- `id` (String) The ID of the service account (`sa-*`).
- `role_id` (String) The org-level role ID assigned to the service account.
